responsibility: This header implements GCC’s generic open-addressed hash_table template, the underlying container used by hash_map and hash_set. It defines the descriptor-based interface for hashing, equality, removal, empty/deleted slot handling, allocation policy, probing, insertion, deletion, resizing, iteration, verification, and GTY/PCH walking, making it the core reusable hash-storage primitive for compiler data structures.
same_name_distinction: Implements the generic hash_table template and related inline algorithms, probing, insertion, removal, iteration, and GTY/PCH hooks. The same-stem .cc file only provides supporting global data and helper functions shared by those templates.
